scope: Offline descriptive reanalysis of frozen P2 distance arrays; no fitting, alignment, reconstruction, or scene rendering

interpretation.height_bins: Uniform absolute-local-Z bins over the whole prism, not building/roof/ground semantic labels; declared before numerical stratification
interpretation.reference_membership: Exact common saved UAS coordinates and original indices must match within each comparison
interpretation.prediction_membership: Different meshes have different area samples; never pair predictions by row index
interpretation.distance_queries: Reuse distances to the original full-prism candidate/reference; do not recrop nearest-neighbor targets per stratum
interpretation.area: Same area-uniform Monte Carlo estimate as existing scoring; distance from observed UAS is not proof of false surface where reference support is absent
interpretation.inference: Descriptive diagnostic only; no optimal threshold selection or confirmatory/scientific verdict
